formula_alignment: Candidate matching uses fixed math token canonicalization (preserve numbers/operators/index markers and unknown macro names; remove only label/tag and display spacing wrappers), SequenceMatcher ratio; known source pages candidate floor0.35, unknown pages exploratory floor0.65 plus runner-up margin0.10. Top-level formula rows match separately but block reconstruction preserves native output order. No string match alone is Q4 confirmation.
code_alignment: Three fixed source chunks (first/middle/last90 normalized characters) in native item stream; unique matches locate item refs. Full reconstructed source text is separately compared; no page assignment from output.
code_quality: Canonical comparison preserves nonwhitespace punctuation/literal identifiers; prompt TeX escaping decoded for visible text. Literal code whitespace/indentation differences remain audit candidates, not automatically semantic equality.

candidate_strata.UNKNOWN: gold UNKNOWN or alignment ambiguous; never silently a miss

channels: RAW=active text; MAPPED=active text if nonempty else orig. Never text/orig union. Markdown delivery separately checked.
fixed50: Use sealed seed/hash/20formula15code15algorithm slots; after all near/error exhausted, fill exact strata by same hash with exact strata disclosed. Hash unit once; pair E0/E1 same source unit where available.
